<a id="op-get-internal-reports"></a>

### `GET /internal/reports`

List this region's most recent report objects, newest first.

- **Operation ID:** `list_reports_internal_reports_get`
- **Tags:** Cost

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `adhoc` | query | boolean | no | `false` | — | List ad-hoc instead of scheduled reports |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | `50` | ≥ 1; ≤ 1000 | Maximum objects returned |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `application/json`: object (free-form) |
| `422` | Validation Error | `application/json`: [`HTTPValidationError`](#schema-httpvalidationerror) |

<a id="op-post-internal-reports"></a>

### `POST /internal/reports`

Generate one ad-hoc allocation report for the trailing window.

- **Operation ID:** `generate_adhoc_report_internal_reports_post`
- **Tags:** Cost

**Request body** (required): `application/json`: [`AdhocReportRequest`](#schema-adhocreportrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `application/json`: object (free-form) |
| `422` | Validation Error | `application/json`: [`HTTPValidationError`](#schema-httpvalidationerror) |

<a id="schema-adhocreportrequest"></a>

### `AdhocReportRequest`

Request body for POST /internal/reports.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `include_rows` | boolean | no | `false` | — | Include the normalized allocation rows in the response |
| `window_hours` | integer | no | `24` | ≥ 1.0; ≤ 168.0 | Trailing window the report covers, in hours |
